title: FSDP dense layer with prefetch
scope: 2 dense Qwen-shaped layers · forward + loss boundary + backward

verification.label: Measured TorchTitan FSDP2 · rank 0 GPU streams
verification.implementation: TorchTitan v0.2.0 dense Qwen3 with explicit dependency-ordered FSDP2 prefetch
verification.workload: Two layers, hidden 4096, 64 Q heads, 4 KV heads, dense SwiGLU 12288, sequence 4096, BF16 parameters, FP32 gradient reduction, FSDP=8
verification.measurement: 35.075 ms full captured step; 33.441 ms displayed window from the L0 forward AG through the final embedding RS
verification.timeline: Collective starts and durations come from the clean Nsight capture; labeled kernels are mapped back to that clean capture.

description: This challenge is a real two-layer TorchTitan FSDP2 trace on eight H100s. Each dense layer contains GQA attention and a dense SwiGLU MLP. Synthetic tokens remove data loading without changing model or collective execution.

Forward prefetch launches the layer 1 parameter all-gather as soon as layer 0 parameters finish materializing. Backward prefetch reconstructs layer 0 while layer 1 backward executes. Gradient reduce-scatter starts as soon as each layer's flat gradient is packed.

The task starts at the layer 0 all-gather. Final norm/output/loss and the embedding backward boundary are fixed context so the puzzle can focus on attention, MLP, layer all-gathers, and layer reduce-scatters.

blocks.label: Layer 0 forward parameter all-gather
blocks.description: Materialize the complete 424 MiB BF16 layer 0 parameter set from eight FSDP shards.

blocks.label: Prefetch layer 1 forward parameters
blocks.description: Layer 0's pre-forward path launches layer 1 prefetch immediately after L0 AG releases the serialized FSDP stream; it overlaps L0 attention.

blocks.label: Layer 0 attention forward
blocks.description: FSDP parameter copy-out, input norm, QKV projections, RoPE, Flash Attention, output projection, and residual.

blocks.label: Layer 0 dense SwiGLU forward
blocks.description: FFN norm, gate/up GEMMs, SiLU multiply, down GEMM, and residual.

blocks.label: Fixed context: final norm and output all-gather
blocks.description: The small shared final-norm/output FSDP state is prefetched while layer 0 MLP executes.

blocks.label: Layer 1 attention forward
blocks.description: Layer 1 parameter copy-out, input norm, GQA attention kernels, output projection, and residual.

blocks.label: Layer 1 dense SwiGLU forward
blocks.description: Dense SwiGLU forward for layer 1, including its norm and residual envelope.

blocks.label: Fixed context: final norm, output, loss, and root backward
blocks.description: The two-layer puzzle keeps the root module and loss visible as fixed context; this block includes root backward and L1 backward parameter copy-out.

blocks.label: Layer 1 backward parameter all-gather
blocks.description: The root output module prefetches layer 1 parameters for backward while output/loss backward executes.

blocks.label: Fixed context: final norm and output reduce-scatter
blocks.description: Shard the root module gradients after its backward pass.

blocks.label: Layer 1 dense SwiGLU backward
blocks.description: Backward through the dense down, activation, gate, and up paths, including FFN normalization work.

blocks.label: Prefetch layer 0 backward parameters
blocks.description: Layer 1 backward launches layer 0 parameter prefetch; it is fully hidden by L1 backward compute.

blocks.label: Layer 1 attention backward
blocks.description: Backward through residual, output projection, Flash Attention, RoPE/QKV, and norms; the envelope ends with flat-gradient packing.

blocks.label: Layer 1 gradient reduce-scatter
blocks.description: FP32 layer 1 gradient sharding begins about 5 µs after gradient packing and overlaps layer 0 MLP backward.

blocks.label: Layer 0 dense SwiGLU backward
blocks.description: Layer 0 parameter copy-out followed by dense SwiGLU and FFN-normalization backward.

blocks.label: Fixed context: embedding backward all-gather
blocks.description: Layer 0 backward prefetches the embedding state. The embedding itself is outside the two-layer puzzle.

blocks.label: Layer 0 attention backward
blocks.description: Layer 0 attention and normalization backward, ending with flat-gradient packing.

blocks.label: Layer 0 gradient reduce-scatter
blocks.description: FP32 layer 0 gradient sharding begins about 6 µs after packing and forms the exposed communication tail.

blocks.label: Fixed context: embedding backward
blocks.description: Embedding gradient kernels execute outside the two-layer puzzle while L0 reduce-scatter runs.

blocks.label: Fixed context: embedding gradient reduce-scatter
blocks.description: The final tiny embedding RS closes the captured backward window.
